name: flatquant_packed_int4_deploy
notes: Reuse the port's overlay.patch pieces, not the whole port: (1) dequantize the exact int32 accumulator in fp32 instead of the repo's deploy.sym_dequant, which truncates it to a multiple of 10 (deploy/kernels/quant.cu, ~3% error per projection, Llama path included); (2) a torch matmul for the head-axis o_proj transform when the head count is not a power of two (the repo's Triton block_matmul does not compile for 12 heads); (3) a load-time probe that picks Triton kron_matmul or torch per Kronecker shape (non-power-of-two factors such as (32,48) and (80,112) passed); (4) an int4 KV cache that keeps the learned KV clip. Kernel files live inside the repo's deploy/ tree, so they apply to FlatQuant checkouts only.
